rules.title: Answer to Complaint
rules.description: Answer to Complaint must be filed within 30 days after service of summons (CCP § 412.20)
rules.text: A defendant must serve and file an answer to the complaint within 30 days after service of the summons and complaint.

rules.title: Motion to Dismiss
rules.description: Demurrer or Motion to Dismiss must be filed within 60 days of appearance or before filing answer, whichever is earlier
rules.text: A defendant may file a demurrer or motion to dismiss within 60 days of appearance or before filing an answer, whichever is earlier.

rules.title: Interrogatories
rules.description: Response to Form Interrogatories and Request for Production must be served within 30 days (CCP § 2030.260)
rules.text: Responses to interrogatories and requests for production must be served within 30 days of being served on the responding party.

rules.title: Requests for Admission
rules.description: Response to Requests for Admission must be served within 30 days (CCP § 2033.250)
rules.text: Responses to requests for admission must be served within 30 days of being served on the responding party.

rules.title: Deposition Notice
rules.description: Notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before deposition date (CCP § 2025.270)
rules.text: A notice of deposition must be served at least 10 days before the deposition date.

rules.title: Motion Filing Notice Period
rules.description: Notice of motion must be served at least 16 court days before hearing (CCP § 1005)
rules.text: A notice of motion must be served at least 16 court days before the hearing date.

rules.title: Appeal Deadline
rules.description: Notice of Appeal must be filed within 60 days after service of Notice of Entry of Judgment (CRC 8.104)
rules.text: A notice of appeal must be filed within 60 days after service of the notice of entry of judgment.

localRules.title: Motion Practice
localRules.text: All motions must be accompanied by a meet-and-confer declaration.

localRules.title: Motion Practice
localRules.text: All motions require a separate statement of undisputed facts.
